template.name: Template App TRASSIR Windows HTTP SDK
template.description: TRASSIR monitoring template for Windows installations using built-in JavaScript HTTP requests in Zabbix Script items to query the TRASSIR Web SDK API. No Zabbix agent, SNMP, or external scripts are required. Monitors TRASSIR health, local cameras, streams, archive retention, and archive disks. Remote NetworkNode channels are excluded.
